title: Passive Intermodulation: The RF Spec That Fails After Installation
summary:
Passive intermodulation is the specification that most often disappears from a component RFQ — and then reappears as a failed system test. It is called passive because the parts that generate it have no active devices in them. A switch contact, a connector interface or a load can all behave as a weak nonlinear junction when two carriers are present.
